model.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
model.package_versions: recorded from the cluster execution environment in the execution sidecar; hook unit tests run in that environment

extraction.slot_definition: slot k = hidden_states[k] = output of decoder block k-1 (0-based); slot 28 after final RMSNorm

directions.pair_contrast: c_{A,B} = unit(t_A - t_B), template T1 unless stated

paraphrase_contrasts.c_cat_anim_T3: unit(t_cat^T3 - mean_{X in A_len} t_X^T3), A_len unchanged, T3 personas P_{X}_T3 for all X in A_len

descriptive.g_anim: unit(mean_{X in A_len + cat} t_X - mean(t_chess, t_blue))
descriptive.e: unit(W_E[plural_A] - W_E[plural_B]) using the leading-space plural rows in the personas

R_cov.construction: Sigma_14 = sample covariance (ddof 1) of the 1,024 P_default slot-14 states (float64). X_c = centered state matrix (1024 x 3584). z = X_c^T g / sqrt(1023), g ~ N(0, I_1024), which samples exactly N(0, Sigma_14) on its (rank-deficient) support without factorizing Sigma. RNG: numpy.random.default_rng(20260925) (PCG64), g drawn as one (1000, 1024) standard_normal array in row order; direction i = unit(z_i).

random.PC_subset: first 200 R_cov directions in generation order
random.sign_convention: random directions are added with sign +1 only; MC p-values are one-sided upper: T_r >= T_obs

structured_null.pairs: all 240 ordered pairs of null_pool.selected_16, T1
structured_null.statistic: same statistic as the tested contrast, same off-target set, norm-matched to the tested magnitude
structured_null.threshold: type-7 quantile at 1 - alpha_TS over the 240 pair statistics
structured_null.se_report: word-level bootstrap: numpy.random.default_rng(20260927), 10000 draws of 16 words with replacement from selected_16; keep ordered pairs of distinct word identities among drawn words (pairs between copies of one word dropped, repeated pairs kept with multiplicity); recompute the type-7 quantile; report SD over draws (reporting only)

intervention.hook: forward hook on decoder block 13 output (slot 14)
intervention.position: absolute index prompt_len - 1, prefill only; answer forms scored from the KV cache without steering

dose.teacher_coordinate: tau(D) = <t_cat, unit(D)> at slot 14 from extraction prompts, written to a hashed sidecar before any steering
dose.null_dose: norm-matched to kappa * |tau(c)| of the compared contrast
dose.PC_pos: raw t_cat added at every prompt position 0..L-1 at slot 14, prefill only

endpoint.word_score: L_w = log sum_{f in F(w)} P(f tokens then any boundary id | prompt)
endpoint.set_log_odds: l_{w,O} = L_w - logsumexp_{o in O} L_o
endpoint.delta: mean over S0 animal-family prompts of steered minus unsteered, family weights 1/3 each (direct, identity, hypothetical)

bootstrap.draw: one index matrix per family, drawn in family order direct, identity, hypothetical: each (10000, 100) integers in [0, 100) with replacement, indexing the family's S0 prompts sorted by prompt_id
bootstrap.sharing: the same index matrices are used for every statistic and every condition (paired bootstrap); differences (steered minus unsteered, contrast minus mention, persona minus default) are computed per replicate before aggregation
bootstrap.estimate: per replicate: mean over families (weight 1/3) of the family mean of the per-prompt statistic
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile interval, numpy.quantile method 'linear' (type 7), probabilities alpha_TS/2 and 1 - alpha_TS/2
bootstrap.ties: a bound exactly equal to 0 counts as not excluding 0

statistics.mc_p_value: (1 + #{T_r >= T_obs}) / (1 + n), reported with MC SE
statistics.interval_level_all_criteria: 1 - alpha_TS (design section 8 applies to every CI in section 8, including PC, PC_star, A6, A7 and the label)

R.statistic: cosine of half-estimates (rows 0-511 vs 512-1023) at slot 14
R.half_axes: t_P^(h) = mu_h(P) - mu_h(P_default), same half h in {rows 0-511, rows 512-1023}; half contrasts are formed from half means of every persona in the formula (for c_cat_anim: all 7 personas); R = cos(direction from half 1, direction from half 2)

TS.b: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O}(+c)) > 0 and CI_high(Delta l_{cat,O}(-c)) < 0; for c_cat_X also CI_low(Delta l_{X,O}(-c)) > 0
TS.c: for every o in O: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,o}(+c)) > 0; for c_cat_X also for every o in O: CI_low(Delta l_{X,o}(-c)) > 0
TS.d: Delta l_{cat,O}(+c) > structured-null threshold AND MC p vs R_cov (n 1000, norm-matched) < alpha_TS
TS.e: for c_cat_dog and c_cat_wolf: point-estimate signs of (b) hold at kappa 0.5 (T1) and with c^T2 and c^T3 at their own kappa 1 doses
TS.c_cat_anim_off_target: O replaced by O_for_c_cat_anim in b, c, d, e and PC_star_anim
TS.e_c_cat_anim: point-estimate signs of (b) (with O_for_c_cat_anim) hold at kappa 0.5 (T1) and with c_cat_anim^T3 = unit(t_cat^T3 - mean_{X in A_len} t_X^T3) at its own kappa 1 dose kappa*|<t_cat^T3, unit(c_cat_anim^T3)>|; T2 is not used for c_cat_anim (rabbit breaks T2 token parity). Researcher decision F01 option A, 2026-09-25.
TS.e_c_cat_anim_interpretation: a TS pass for c_cat_anim establishes robustness to one independent persona paraphrase (T3) only; it must not be described as robustness across multiple paraphrases or templates

criteria.PC: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O_panel}(t_cat)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS AND MC p vs first 200 R_cov at magnitude ||t_cat|| < alpha_PC
criteria.PC_star_X: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O}) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, O = O_panel minus X
criteria.PC_pos: PC criterion with t_cat added at every prompt position 0..L-1 (slot 14, prefill); MC reference = the same first 200 R_cov directions added at every position at magnitude ||t_cat||. Computed always; used only by decision ranks 2-3.
criteria.A1: all four singular forms single tokens (decided pre-freeze: dog pass, wolf pass)
criteria.A2: T1 persona contains the leading-space plural once per mention as a single token and has the same token count as P_cat (decided pre-freeze: dog pass, wolf pass)
criteria.A3: decided pre-freeze from recorded evidence (dog pass, wolf pass-weak)

A4.statistic: mean over S0 animal-family prompts (family weights 1/3) of exp(L_X), unsteered, default context

criteria.A6: unsteered: CI_low(l_{X,O}(P_X T1 system prompt) - l_{X,O}(default)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, O = O_panel minus X
criteria.A7: CI_low(Delta l_{X,O}(raw t_X)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, O = O_panel minus X

order.rerun: at most one, documented infrastructure cause only; all attempts reported

order.if: (not PC and not PC_pos) or not R_t_cat

order.note: overrides any TS pass: rank 3 is evaluated before ranks 4-5

order.if: first X in candidates.order with A4 and A5 and A6 and A7
TS(c_cat_anim) or TS(c_cat_X) for some X
order.stage2a_primary: c_cat_anim if TS(c_cat_anim) else first passing c_cat_X in candidate order

order.if: none of ranks 1-5, and PC_star_dog, PC_star_wolf and PC_star_anim all fail
order.note: logically equivalent restatement of design v1 step 6 given that no contrast passes TS when ranks 4-5 do not apply (freeze audit F02)

label.PREFERENCE_CONTRAST: CI_low(Delta l_{cat,O}(+c) - Delta l_{cat,O}(+m)) > 0 at level 1 - alpha_TS, m the matching mention contrast at the same magnitude (for c_cat_anim: m_cat_dog and m_cat_wolf both, with O_for_c_cat_anim)

integrity_checks: extraction file SHA-256 and prompts_json_sha256 on the execution host equal MANIFEST.external_inputs; tokenizer file hashes equal MANIFEST.external_inputs
render identity test passes on all 1024 extraction rows
all 1024 extraction rows and all S0 prompts present for every persona and condition
unsteered log-probs identical within 1e-4 across repeated baseline runs
no D or C prompt id appears in any Stage-0 output
runtime re-tokenization in the execution environment reproduces every token id in cts_stage0_personas.json and cts_stage0_endpoint_tokens.json and the boundary_ids_sha256

stage2a_precommitments.random_matching: variance-matched to the natural S-N coordinate on D
